changeSet.author: welcome-home
changeSet.comment: The app may make an admin of an owner who registered without the role, and only that.
changeSet.sql: CREATE FUNCTION make_admin(requested_owner_id uuid) RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE sql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = pg_catalog, pg_temp AS $$ WITH made AS ( UPDATE public.owner SET is_admin = true WHERE id = requested_owner_id AND NOT is_admin RETURNING id ) SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM made); $$;
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION make_admin(uuid) FROM PUBLIC; GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION make_admin(uuid) TO app_user;
